payload.text:
Prove this Lean 4 theorem (source: LeanCat, difficulty: medium).

Informal statement:
Let G and H be groups. If their binary coproduct exists in the category of groups, then the free product of G and H is isomorphic to that categorical coproduct.

Formal statement to prove:
theorem freeProdGrp_iso_coprod [HasBinaryCoproduct G H] :
    Nonempty (GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ≅ coprod G H)

The theorem is stated in this context (already in scope; do not restate it, and keep these when you write the proof):
open CategoryTheory Limits
universe u
variable {G H : GrpCat.{u}}

Use the typed subgoal tools to decompose, verify, review, and route. For this medium task, define four to six concrete compile-verifiable artifacts; do not use vague understand/find/investigate subgoals. Build at least two work subgoals plus one final integration subgoal; use sequential dependencies when the mathematics is sequential. Do not use HANDOFF or VERDICT text markers. Use search_lemmas and compiler tools when they resolve real uncertainty. Hand off only when the receiving role can act on concrete mathematical, compiler, or review evidence. A non-linear route is allowed, but extra communication is not itself success. The final proof must compile, preserve the exact statement, and contain no sorry, admit, or added axiom.

{"code":"theorem test_sg1 [HasBinaryCoproduct G H] :
  Nonempty (GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ⟶ coprod G H) := by
  let f_inl : G ⟶ coprod G H := coprod.inl
  let f_inr : H ⟶ coprod G H := coprod.inr
  -- Now I need to convert these to homomorphisms
  let h_inl : ↑G →* ↑(coprod G H) := GrpCat.Hom.hom' f_inl
  let h_inr : ↑H →* ↑(coprod G H) := GrpCat.Hom.hom' f_inr
  -- Now use Monoid.Coprod.lift
  let h : Monoid.Coprod G H →* ↑(coprod G H) := Monoid.Coprod.lift h_inl h_inr
  -- Convert back to morphism
  let f : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ⟶ coprod G H := GrpCat.ofHom h
  exact ⟨f⟩","subgoal_id":"sg1","purpose":"probe"}

{"code":"theorem test_sg3 [HasBinaryCoproduct G H] :
  let f_inl : G ⟶ coprod G H := coprod.inl
  let f_inr : H ⟶ coprod G H := coprod.inr
  let h_inl : ↑G →* ↑(coprod G H) := GrpCat.Hom.hom' f_inl
  let h_inr : ↑H →* ↑(coprod G H) := GrpCat.Hom.hom' f_inr
  let h : Monoid.Coprod G H →* ↑(coprod G H) := Monoid.Coprod.lift h_inl h_inr
  let f : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ⟶ coprod G H := GrpCat.ofHom h
  let g_inl : ↑G →* Monoid.Coprod G H := Monoid.Coprod.inl
  let g_inr : ↑H →* Monoid.Coprod G H := Monoid.Coprod.inr
  let f_g_inl : G ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := GrpCat.ofHom g_inl
  let f_g_inr : H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := GrpCat.ofHom g_inr
  let g : coprod G H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := coprod.desc f_g_inl f_g_inr
  g ≫ f = 1 := by
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.hom_ext
  · -- Show coprod.inl ≫ (g ≫ f) = coprod.inl ≫ 1
    dsimp
    rw [CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.inl_desc]
    simp [GrpCat.ofHom_comp, Monoid.Coprod.lift_apply_inl]
  · -- Show coprod.inr ≫ (g ≫ f) = coprod.inr ≫ 1
    dsimp
    rw [CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.inr_desc]
    simp [GrpCat.ofHom_comp, Monoid.Coprod.lift_apply_inr]","subgoal_id":"sg3","purpose":"probe"}

{"code":"theorem test_sg3 [HasBinaryCoproduct G H] :
  let f_inl : G ⟶ coprod G H := coprod.inl
  let f_inr : H ⟶ coprod G H := coprod.inr
  let h_inl : ↑G →* ↑(coprod G H) := GrpCat.Hom.hom' f_inl
  let h_inr : ↑H →* ↑(coprod G H) := GrpCat.Hom.hom' f_inr
  let h : Monoid.Coprod G H →* ↑(coprod G H) := Monoid.Coprod.lift h_inl h_inr
  let f : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ⟶ coprod G H := GrpCat.ofHom h
  let g_inl : ↑G →* Monoid.Coprod G H := Monoid.Coprod.inl
  let g_inr : ↑H →* Monoid.Coprod G H := Monoid.Coprod.inr
  let f_g_inl : G ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := GrpCat.ofHom g_inl
  let f_g_inr : H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := GrpCat.ofHom g_inr
  let g : coprod G H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := coprod.desc f_g_inl f_g_inr
  g ≫ f = 1 := by
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.hom_ext
  · -- Show coprod.inl ≫ (g ≫ f) = coprod.inl ≫ 1
    dsimp
    simp [Category.assoc, CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.inl_desc]
    rw [← GrpCat.ofHom_comp]
    simp [Monoid.Coprod.lift_apply_inl]
    simp [GrpCat.ofHom_hom']
  · -- Show coprod.inr ≫ (g ≫ f) = coprod.inr ≫ 1
    dsimp
    simp [Category.assoc, CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.inr_desc]
    rw [← GrpCat.ofHom_comp]
    simp [Monoid.Coprod.lift_apply_inr]
    simp [GrpCat.ofHom_hom']","subgoal_id":"sg3","purpose":"probe"}

  let f : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ⟶ coprod G H := GrpCat.ofHom h
  let g_inl : ↑G →* Monoid.Coprod G H := Monoid.Coprod.inl
  let g_inr : ↑H →* Monoid.Coprod G H := Monoid.Coprod.inr
  let f_g_inl : G ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := GrpCat.ofHom g_inl
  let f_g_inr : H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := GrpCat.ofHom g_inr
  let g : coprod G H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := coprod.desc f_g_inl f_g_inr

  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.hom_ext

    -- We need to show that GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.inl ≫ (Monoid.Coprod.lift coprod.inl.hom' coprod.inr.hom')) = coprod.inl

  let f : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ⟶ coprod G H := GrpCat.ofHom h

  let g : coprod G H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := coprod.desc f_g_inl f_g_inr
  -- Show that g ≫ f = 1
  have h1 : g ≫ f = 1 := by
    apply CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.hom_ext
    · dsimp
      simp [Category.assoc, CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.inl_desc]
      -- Now we have: GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inl ≫ GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.lift coprod.inl.hom' coprod.inr.hom') = coprod.inl ≫ 1
      -- Use the fact that GrpCat.ofHom is a functor
      simp [GrpCat.ofHom_comp, Monoid.Coprod.lift_apply_inl, GrpCat.ofHom_hom]
    · dsimp
      simp [Category.assoc, CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.inr_desc]
      simp [GrpCat.ofHom_comp, Monoid.Coprod.lift_apply_inr, GrpCat.ofHom_hom]
  -- Show that f ≫ g = 1
  have h2 : f ≫ g = 1 := by
    -- Use the universal property of Monoid.Coprod

  let f_inr : H ⟶ coprod G H := coprod.inr
  let h_inl : ↑G →* ↑(coprod G H) := GrpCat.Hom.hom' f_inl
  let h_inr : ↑H →* ↑(coprod G H) := GrpCat.Hom.hom' f_inr
  let h : Monoid.Coprod G H →* ↑(coprod G H) := Monoid.Coprod.lift h_inl h_inr
  let f : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ⟶ coprod G H := GrpCat.ofHom h
  let g_inl : ↑G →* Monoid.Coprod G H := Monoid.Coprod.inl
  let g_inr : ↑H →* Monoid.Coprod G H := Monoid.Coprod.inr
  let f_g_inl : G ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := GrpCat.ofHom g_inl
  let f_g_inr : H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := GrpCat.ofHom g_inr
  let g : coprod G H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := coprod.desc f_g_inl f_g_inr
  g ≫ f = 1 := by
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.hom_ext
  · -- Show coprod.inl ≫ (g ≫ f) = coprod.inl ≫ 1
    dsimp
    simp [Category.assoc, CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.inl_desc]
    -- Now we have: GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inl ≫ GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.lift coprod.inl.hom' coprod.inr.hom') = coprod.inl ≫ 1
    -- Try using the fact that GrpCat.ofHom is a functor
    -- The key insight is that GrpCat.ofHom (g.comp f) = GrpCat.ofHom f ≫ GrpCat.ofHom g
    -- So we need to show that GrpCat.ofHom ((Monoid.Coprod.lift ...).comp Monoid.Coprod.inl) = coprod.inl

    -- So we need to show that GrpCat.ofHom coprod.inl.hom' = coprod.inl
    -- And coprod.inl.hom' = GrpCat.Hom.hom' coprod.inl
    -- So we need to show that GrpCat.ofHom (GrpCat.Hom.hom' coprod.inl) = coprod.inl
    -- By GrpCat.ofHom_hom, this is true
    -- Let me try to use simp with the right lemmas
    simp [GrpCat.ofHom_comp, Monoid.Coprod.lift_apply_inl, GrpCat.ofHom_hom]
  · -- Show coprod.inr ≫ (g ≫ f) = coprod.inr ≫ 1
    dsimp
    simp [Category.assoc, CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.inr_desc]
    simp [GrpCat.ofHom_comp, Monoid.Coprod.lift_apply_inr, GrpCat.ofHom_hom]","subgoal_id":"sg3","purpose":"subgoal"}

{"code":"theorem test_sg3 [HasBinaryCoproduct G H] :
  let f_inl : G ⟶ coprod G H := coprod.inl
  let f_inr : H ⟶ coprod G H := coprod.inr
  let h_inl : ↑G →* ↑(coprod G H) := GrpCat.Hom.hom' f_inl
  let h_inr : ↑H →* ↑(coprod G H) := GrpCat.Hom.hom' f_inr
  let h : Monoid.Coprod G H →* ↑(coprod G H) := Monoid.Coprod.lift h_inl h_inr
  let f : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ⟶ coprod G H := GrpCat.ofHom h
  let g_inl : ↑G →* Monoid.Coprod G H := Monoid.Coprod.inl
  let g_inr : ↑H →* Monoid.Coprod G H := Monoid.Coprod.inr
  let f_g_inl : G ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := GrpCat.ofHom g_inl
  let f_g_inr : H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := GrpCat.ofHom g_inr
  let g : coprod G H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := coprod.desc f_g_inl f_g_inr
  g ≫ f = 1 := by
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.hom_ext
  · -- Show coprod.inl ≫ (g ≫ f) = coprod.inl ≫ 1
    dsimp
    simp [Category.assoc, CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.inl_desc]
    -- Now we have: GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inl ≫ GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.lift coprod.inl.hom' coprod.inr.hom') = coprod.inl ≫ 1
    -- Use the fact that GrpCat.ofHom is a functor
    -- The key insight is that GrpCat.ofHom (g.comp f) = GrpCat.ofHom f ≫ GrpCat.ofHom g
    -- So we need to show that GrpCat.ofHom ((Monoid.Coprod.lift ...).comp Monoid.Coprod.inl) = coprod.inl
    -- By Monoid.Coprod.lift_apply_inl, (Monoid.Coprod.lift ...).comp Monoid.Coprod.inl = coprod.inl.hom'
    -- So we need to show that GrpCat.ofHom coprod.inl.hom' = coprod.inl
    -- And coprod.inl.hom' = GrpCat.Hom.hom' coprod.inl
    -- So we need to show that GrpCat.ofHom (GrpCat.Hom.hom' coprod.inl) = coprod.inl
    -- By GrpCat.ofHom_hom, this is true
    -- Let me try to use simp with the right lemmas
    simp [← GrpCat.ofHom_comp, Monoid.Coprod.lift_apply_inl, GrpCat.ofHom_hom]
  · -- Show coprod.inr ≫ (g ≫ f) = coprod.inr ≫ 1
    dsimp
    simp [Category.assoc, CategoryTheory.Limits.coprod.inr_desc]
    simp [← GrpCat.ofHom_comp, Monoid.Coprod.lift_apply_inr, GrpCat.ofHom_hom]","subgoal_id":"sg3","purpose":"subgoal"}

  let h : Monoid.Coprod G H →* ↑(coprod G H) := Monoid.Coprod.lift h_inl h_inr
  let f : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ⟶ coprod G H := GrpCat.ofHom h
  let g_inl : ↑G →* Monoid.Coprod G H := Monoid.Coprod.inl
  let g_inr : ↑H →* Monoid.Coprod G H := Monoid.Coprod.inr
  let f_g_inl : G ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := GrpCat.ofHom g_inl
  let f_g_inr : H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := GrpCat.ofHom g_inr
  let g : coprod G H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) := coprod.desc f_g_inl f_g_inr
  g ≫ f = 1 := by

    -- And coprod.inl.hom' = GrpCat.Hom.hom' coprod.inl
    -- So we need to show that GrpCat.ofHom (GrpCat.Hom.hom' coprod.inl) = coprod.inl

    rw [GrpCat.ofHom_hom]
